title: Verify Home Page Loads Successfully on Desktop
description: Check that the Home page loads successfully and displays the sports ecosystem overview correctly on a desktop browser.

steps.description: Open the SocioSports website Home page on a desktop browser.
Verify that the main ecosystem overview content is visible and displayed properly.
Ensure all sections such as athlete highlights, trainer profiles, and community links are present.

title: Verify Home Page Responsiveness on Mobile
description: Check that the Home page layout adjusts properly and remains fully functional on various mobile devices.

steps.description: Open the SocioSports Home page on mobile viewport sizes (e.g., iPhone, Android).
Verify the page layout adapts correctly with no content overflow or misaligned elements.
Ensure all interactive elements are accessible and usable on touch screens.

title: Event Listing Displays Upcoming Events Correctly
description: Validate that the Events page lists upcoming sports events with correct details for each event.

steps.description: Navigate to the Events page from the main navigation.
Check that a list of upcoming sports events is displayed.
Validate event details such as event name, date, location, and brief description are present and accurate.

title: Event Detail View Loads and Displays Correct Data
description: Confirm detailed view of an event loads correctly with comprehensive information and booking options.

steps.description: Click on an event from the Events listing page to view detailed information.
Verify event full details including schedule, venue, and organizer info are displayed.
Ensure vendor/stall booking options are presented and functional.

title: Blog Page Loads Articles, Podcasts, and Stories
description: Check the Blog page content hub displays all types of content including articles, podcasts, and athlete stories.

steps.description: Navigate to the Blog page.
Verify articles are shown with main headlines and summaries.
Check that podcasts and athlete story sections are visible and content plays or displays accordingly.

title: Mobile App Promotion Section Links and Tracking
description: Validate that the Mobile App Promotion section displays correct download links and conversion tracking is integrated.

steps.description: Navigate to the Home page and locate the Mobile App Promotion section.
Verify presence of download links for Android and iOS apps.
Confirm analytics tracking events are triggered when clicking the app download links.

title: Admin CMS Dashboard Load and Basic Functionality
description: Verify admin users can access the CMS dashboard and perform key functions such as creating and editing blog posts.

steps.description: Login as an admin user and navigate to the CMS dashboard.
Confirm dashboard loads with sections for blogs, events, and content moderation.
Attempt to create a new blog post with title, body, and metadata.
Verify new blog post is saved successfully and appears in the blog list.
Edit an existing blog post and save changes.
Confirm changes are saved and reflected on the public blog page.

title: Contact Page Inquiry and Event Booking Form Validation
description: Check that the Contact page form validates user input and initiates backend workflows upon submission.

steps.description: Navigate to the Contact page.
Fill in the inquiry form with valid data and select an event booking.
Submit the contact form.
Verify form submission is successful and acknowledgement message is shown.

title: Contact Page Form Input Validation Errors
description: Validate the Contact page form input fields enforce validation and display appropriate error messages for invalid inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to Contact page.
Attempt to submit the form with empty required fields.
Verify validation error messages are displayed for each missing required field.
Enter invalid email format and attempt to submit.
Verify appropriate error message indicating invalid email format is shown.

title: SEO Meta Tags and Page Titles are Present and Correct
description: Ensure all core pages have the correct SEO meta tags and titles to support search engine optimization.

steps.description: Open Home, Events, Blog, About Us, and Contact pages.
Verify each page includes relevant meta title, description, and keywords tags.
Check page titles in the browser tab reflect the page content accurately.

title: Google Analytics Tracking Fires on Key User Interactions
description: Validate that Google Analytics events and conversion tracking are triggered on key user interactions across the site.

steps.description: Navigate through multiple pages including Home, Events, Blog.
Trigger an app download click from the Mobile App Promotion section.
Submit inquiry form on Contact page.
Check network tools or analytics debugger to confirm that relevant GA events are sent.

title: Ensure WCAG Accessibility Compliance on Core Pages
description: Verify that key pages meet accessibility standards including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and ARIA attributes.

steps.description: Test navigation on Home, Events, Blog, About Us, and Contact pages using keyboard only.
Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible and focus states are visible.
Use screen reader to validate correct reading order and labeling of elements.
Check color contrast ratios meet minimum WCAG requirements.

title: Performance Testing for Page Load Times
description: Validate that core pages load within performance benchmarks under normal network conditions.

steps.description: Load Home, Events, Blog, About Us, and Contact pages under typical bandwidth (e.g., 3G, 4G).
Measure and verify that page load times meet the defined performance targets (e.g., under 3 seconds).
Verify that assets are optimized and no unnecessary large requests are made.

title: CMS Content Moderation Reject and Approve Flows
description: Ensure admin users can moderate content by approving or rejecting blog posts and events appropriately.

steps.description: Login as admin and select a pending blog post or event.
Perform content rejection with reason and save.
Verify rejected content is marked accordingly and not published on the live site.
Approve a pending content item.
Confirm the content appears published and visible to all users.
